Title: Hyperscale (Citus) is now in preview on Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
We’re excited to announce preview of Hyperscale (Citus), a new deployment option for Azure Database for PostgreSQL that scales out Postgres horizontally. Hyperscale (Citus) is ideal for multi-tenant and SaaS applications that are growing fast—and for real-time analytics apps that need sub-second response times across billions of rows. With Hyperscale (Citus), organizations never have to worry about scaling their databases again. Read more about this announcement in our Azure blog post.

Read more about this announcement in our Azure blog post.
